paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : IWSLT14 De
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between BLEU scores and Average Lagging (AL) for four different machine translation models, as identified in the legend. The x-axis is labeled "Average Lagging (AL)" and utilizes a linear scale ranging from approximately 1.5 to 11.5, with numeric tick labels positioned at intervals of 2.5, from 2.5 to 10.0. The y-axis is labeled "BLEU" and uses a linear scale with a visible range from roughly 25.2 to 34, featuring numeric tick labels at intervals of 1, from 26 to 34, accompanied by horizontal dashed grid lines. The line representing "Consistency-CE" is light purple, features circle markers, and uses a dashed line style. It shows a steady upward trend, starting at an AL of approximately 2.0 with a BLEU score of 26.1 and ending at an AL of 10.5 with a BLEU score of roughly 31.3, passing through intermediate points such as (5.9, 30.3) and (8.3, 31.1). The "Inconsistency-CE" line is dark purple with square markers and a dashed line style. It also follows a continuous upward trend, beginning near an AL of 1.9 and a BLEU score of 26.3, passing through (6.0, 30.3), and concluding at an AL of roughly 10.4 with a BLEU score of 31.4. The "Inconsistency-CE-MP" line is blue, uses square markers, and has a dashed line style. This line increases continuously from an initial AL of about 1.9 and a BLEU score of 26.8, reaching a final AL of 10.4 with a BLEU score of 32.2, with notable intermediate points at (5.9, 31.0) and (8.2, 31.8). Finally, the "Consistency-Bi" line is red, uses star markers, and has a solid line style. It begins further along the x-axis at an AL of roughly 3.7 with a BLEU score of 30.3, and steadily rises through points such as (7.2, 32.3) and (8.2, 32.7) to end at an AL of 11.1 with a BLEU score of 33.0.
